mapping: traj timestamp t (s, relative to window start) <-> video frame index round(t * fps)
uncertainty: resampling from 30 fps source to 15 fps: up to ±16.7 ms (half source frame); pixel-verified externally at probe frames (r=0.998/0.999, 0 ms offset) for the validated example. For new windows without a pixel check, treat as frame-count-verified only.
